name: PrintableTools Lab Paid Services

services.name: Custom Local Print Pack Setup
services.description: A $29 done-for-you setup request for one simple printable seller pack: price tags, flyer copy, QR sign text, coupon wording, packing slip starter rows, and a one-page launch checklist.

orderPipeline.ownerAction: A buyer submits the structured issue form, prefilled issue, email, or brief text.
Confirm the request is within the simple $29 scope and details are complete enough.
orderPipeline.buyerAction: Confirm scope and that the QR/contact link can be printed publicly.

orderPipeline.ownerAction: Send one real external Gumroad, Payhip, Ko-fi, Stripe, or invoice checkout link.
orderPipeline.buyerAction: Pay only through the external provider.
orderPipeline.moneyRule: Not revenue until the provider confirms payment.

orderPipeline.ownerAction: Verify paid order, payout balance, or settled payment in the provider dashboard.
orderPipeline.moneyRule: This is the first status that can count as revenue.

orderPipeline.ownerAction: Prepare the editable starter CSV, flyer copy, QR sign wording, coupon ideas, packing notes, and launch checklist.
orderPipeline.buyerAction: Answer scope clarifications only if needed.

orderPipeline.ownerAction: Send the pack through the agreed channel with review and QR-test reminders.
orderPipeline.buyerAction: Review all copy, prices, QR links, and claims before printing.

orderPipeline.ownerAction: Complete the included lightweight typo or fit revision if requested.
orderPipeline.buyerAction: Confirm the revision request is within scope.
orderPipeline.moneyRule: No extra revenue unless a separate new paid scope is created.

orderPipeline.ownerAction: Log the non-sensitive outcome in OPERATIONS.md and leave private payment details in the provider only.
orderPipeline.buyerAction: Use the editable pack in their own business or event workflow.
orderPipeline.moneyRule: Final counted revenue must match the external provider record.

services.turnaround: Target delivery is 2 business days after real payment and complete buyer details.
deliverables: price tag starter CSV for up to 12 items
QR sign wording for one link or contact method
three coupon or bundle offer ideas
packing slip or pickup note starter rows
one-page launch checklist for printing and first outreach
buyerInputs: business, event, booth, or service name
up to 12 items or services with prices
one URL, social profile, phone, or email to turn into QR sign wording
preferred style: clean, cute, bold, minimal, local, premium, or practical
any words, claims, or offers to avoid
riskControls: The service does not start until a real external payment link is sent and paid.
No payout, tax, bank, card, identity, or platform credential is stored in the repository.
The buyer must review all copy, prices, QR links, and claims before printing or publishing.
No legal, tax, accounting, employment, medical, or financial advice is included.
One lightweight revision is included for typos or fit; new branding, logo design, or legal copy is out of scope.
services.successGate: Revenue is proven only after a real payment provider shows a paid order, payout balance, or settled payment for this service.

moneyGate: Revenue is real only when a payment provider shows a paid order, payout balance, or settled payment.
